articles.summary: Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota, recently hosted its annual Sales Expo, welcoming 51 professionals from 28 sign companies for three days of hands-on training, product exploration and peer networking.
articles.title: Sales Expo 2025 Strengthens Sign Company Partnerships and Showcases Design Excellence

articles.summary: When Oklahoma State fans head to Cowgirl Stadium in Stillwater, Oklahoma, in 2026, they will be greeted by college softball’s largest LED video display, manufactured and installed by Daktronics (NASDAQ-DAKT) of Brookings, South Dakota.
articles.title: Oklahoma State Engages Fans with Largest LED Video Display in College Softball from Daktronics
